item.title: backlog edit has no --remove-ac N flag — individual ACs cannot be removed
item.intent: Users must be able to remove a specific AC by 1-based index via backlog edit <ID> --remove-ac N without clearing all acceptance criteria.
item.description: backlog edit supports --ac to append acceptance criteria and --clear-ac to wipe all ACs, but no way to remove a single AC by index. This is the same gap as missing --remove-step (BUG-115) but for the AC array. AC entries can be plain strings or {text, verify} objects — the jq del() removal must handle both.
steps: Add --remove-ac flag to cmd_backlog_edit() option parser
Validate the argument is a positive integer
After loading the item, use jq to remove the (N-1)th element from acceptanceCriteria array (1-based input)
If N is out of range, exit non-zero with clear error: 'AC N does not exist (item has M ACs)'
Write back atomically using temp file + mv pattern
Add --remove-ac to backlog edit usage message
Run shellcheck and confirm zero new warnings
acceptanceCriteria: backlog edit ID --remove-ac 1 removes the first AC from the item
backlog edit ID --remove-ac 99 exits non-zero with a clear error when index is out of range
Removal works correctly for both plain-string ACs and {text, verify} object ACs
All other fields on the item are unchanged after removal
shellcheck passes with zero new warnings
